Name: Town Talks
Author: Nicolas2489
Description:
Pelican Town has opinions about your love life. Custom dialogue and letters from five core villagers react to your romantic situation with a mix of drama, cosmic support, flustered concern, and deadpan indifference. Designed for use with Free Love but works without it.✦ Features:
Haley — five stages of reaction from scandalized to genuinely jealous, constant gossip
Emily — immediately and completely spiritually at peace with everything, gives crystals
Penny — flustered but trying SO hard to be supportive, asks how you track everyone's birthdays
Sebastian — deadpan, completely unbothered, writes you a rare heartfelt letter
Alex — supportive for entirely the wrong reasons, gridball metaphors, cries at your wedding but calls it medical
letters total triggering across friendship milestones and the marriage flag
Wedding congratulations letter from the whole town with 1000g⚙
Requirements:
Content Patcher 2.8.0+Free Love by aedenthorn (recommended, not required)📦 Installation
Download and unzip the mod folder.Drop the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods/ directory.Launch the game through SMAPI.💡 Note: Pairs with Town Talks Social Arc for the full four-phase gossip experience

This would be my first mod I made and posted, so any questions, critiques or concerns are surely appreciated
